stories.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs and normalized outputs, including condition, location, recruiting flag, and enriched distance fields.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search service into EvaluateCare facade, enabling orchestrated calls from the application layer and standardized response formatting for downstream tool usage.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool via the tool router with validated inputs, enabling LLM-driven invocation within the chat workflow.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create unit tests for query building, parsing, and distance computation, plus integration tests covering facade orchestration and tool invocation paths with mocked external APIs.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file; must create backend/tests/test_clinical_trials_service.py and integration coverage
